title: Sodium reduction rules for programs that adopt them
jurisdiction: Global default derived from the WHO sodium guideline

rules.message: Sodium above 700 mg in one meal (about a third of the 2 g daily guideline).
rules.source: WHO sodium intake guideline (2012): under 2 g sodium (5 g salt) per day

rules.message: A single meal with more than 1 g of sodium is half the daily guideline; programs that adopt this pack do not serve it.
rules.source: Derived from the WHO sodium intake guideline (2012)

rules.message: Sodium above 2 g per person per day.

disclaimer: DRAFT derived from public guidance. Not medical advice. Population-level rules only; people with clinician-set sodium targets are handled locally through PersonNutrition, never through this pack. Must be reviewed by a registered dietitian before adoption.
